description: This file defines a React component for a sidebar menu using Ant Design components, with role-based filtering and navigation logic for a web application's UI.

classes.name: SidebarProps
classes.description: Props accepted by the Sidebar2 React component, including user role and access token information.

classes.name: MenuItemCfg
classes.description: Configuration object for individual menu items, including roles, labels, icons, and nested children.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the normalized base URL path considering environment variables and server root path.

methods.name: routeFor
methods.description: Maps legacy page IDs to actual route paths used within the application.

methods.name: toHref
methods.description: Generates full link URLs based on route paths and base path.
